title: Which country will win the men's basketball bronze medal at the 2026 Asian Games?
background: This question concerns the five-on-five basketball tournament, rather than the separate three-on-three competition.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official Asian Games competition results or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the completed bronze-medal match. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the country that wins the bronze-medal match in the men's basketball tournament at the 2026 Asian Games, once the final result is announced. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The country's short English name.
